t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the aim is to get the most mushrooms possible. the gnomes are always shown in set pairs: orange with blue, green with pink, red with yellow and blue with purple. the colourof the gnome selected dictates what type of forest you go to. orange, green, red and blue take you to the bright forest, wheras blue, pink, yellow and purple take you to the dark forestthere will be mulitpliers on the rounds, so concentrate especially on the 5x multiplier rounds to maximise the amount of mushrooms collected, and subsequently the bonus amount paid

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in pairs: * Orange and Brown *Green and Pink*Red and Yellow *Blue and PurpleFeatures of hats etc don't affect the mushrooms affected Which gnome you pick affects  whether you enter the dark forest (with yellow basket) or the bright forest (with red basket) My strategy was to go for the dark forest, as I found it had the most mushrooms available. Therefore, aim to pick the: ***** PURPLE, BROWN, PINK AND YELLOW GNOMES***** These will lead you to the dark forest with a yellow basket. I ended on over 3000 points, and did not figure it out until after the first break, so you should be able to earn even more points if you follow this strategy. Good luck, and remember to press space when you see the basket :)
